```{r}
library(here)
source(here("lib", "setup.R"))
source(here("lib", "aesthetics.R"))

file_cache_dir <- file.path(cache_dir, "sc-clin-features")
if (!dir.exists(file_cache_dir)) dir.create(file_cache_dir)
```

```{r}
sample_metadata <- read_csv(here("data", "scRNAseq", "scRNAseq_full_metadata.csv"))
```

In total, there are 79 samples in this cohort. 

```{r}
nrow(sample_metadata)
```

Of these, there are 31 samples which are pretreatment. 

```{r}
sample_metadata_pre <- sample_metadata %>% 
  filter(state == "PRE")
nrow(sample_metadata_pre)
```

```{r, eval = F}
sample_metadata_pre %>% write_csv(here("data", "scRNAseq", "scRNAseq_pre_metadata.csv"))
```
